description: This source file defines a Java class 'XBRLIntegrationTestHelper' that provides helper methods for integration testing related to XBRL taxonomy and mapping endpoints in the Fineract project. It includes deprecated methods for retrieving taxonomy lists and mappings via server GET requests.
